# LIBRARY — primary sources, banked locally

> ⛔ **The rule** (CLAUDE.md, *Research banking*): **a research
> deliverable that cites a paper it did not bank is incomplete.** Add
> with `python tools/kb_add.py <arxiv-id-or-url> --tag <topic>
> --cited-by <path-of-your-report>`; never hand-edit this file — it is
> generated from `library.json` by `--reindex`.

> A `[PUBLISHED]` entry in any `KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md` should cite the
> library key, not only a URL. A URL is a claim about the internet; a
> banked sha256 is a claim about a file we hold.

### `action-conditioning` (3)

- **[2607.26712](TanitAD%20Research%20Lab/Library/papers/2607.26712_ActSWM-Action-Sensitive-World-Models-for-Long-Horizon-Planni.pdf)** — ActSWM: Action-Sensitive World Models for Long-Horizon Planning in Open-World Games  
  *ActSWM: names our failure CONTEXT COLLAPSE (rollouts insensitive to actions while matching future states); diagnoses it with a recorded-vs-ZERO-action gap = our zero_sa; fix = HINGE loss on rollout separation + a RANDOMLY-INITIALISED FROZEN action readout on [z_t,z_t+1] whose loss backprops through the LATENT INPUTS (so it shapes the ENCODER, unlike our O11 which only touched the predictor FiLM); AND independently reproduces our O11 degeneracy - a JOINTLY TRAINED readout raised separation while fidelity fell 0.972->0.698*
- **[2412.05337](TanitAD%20Research%20Lab/Library/papers/2412.05337_ACT-Bench-Towards-Action-Controllable-World-Models-for-Auton.pdf)** — ACT-Bench: Towards Action Controllable World Models for Autonomous Driving  
  *queued for the action-conditioning review | ACT-Bench: action fidelity = generate future VIDEO from a commanded trajectory, recover it with an INDEPENDENT trajectory estimator, score ADE/FDE. NOT RUNNABLE for us — we have no latent->video decoder (ACT_BENCH_ADOPTION.md). Its independent-estimator PRINCIPLE is what our ridge probes already satisfy.*
- **[1905.11979](TanitAD%20Research%20Lab/Library/papers/1905.11979_Causal-Confusion-in-Imitation-Learning.pdf)** — Causal Confusion in Imitation Learning  
  *queued for the action-conditioning review | Causal confusion in imitation learning: MORE information (past action / longer history) yields WORSE policies; the confounded 'no-frame-history' policy beats the history one*
